title: Rapid, high-throughput homogenization of embryonic or larval zebrafish \(Danio rerio)
protocol: Place 10-300 mg of zebrafish into microcentrifuge tubes.
Add two masses of zirconium oxide grinding beads for each mass of sample.
Add 2 volumes of buffer for every mass of zebrafish.
Close the microcentrifuge tubes and place them into the Bullet Blender™ (no need to balance).
Set controls for SPEED 8 and TIME 3 minutes, then start the run.
Remove tubes and proceed with your downstream application.
